description: Use for "which campaign sends the best visitors?", "which landing page is weakest?" or "where do visitors from each campaign drop out?". Returns, per campaign (utm_campaign or campaign id, plus visits not tagged with a campaign) for the last 7 and 30 days: visits, the share who left straight away (one page, no scroll past the first quarter), who viewed a product, reached the cart and reached checkout (or "not visible" when the checkout runs on a separate Shopify checkout page), pages per visit, the top landing page, the weakest step, and which campaign is best and weakest. Same table as the app's Funnel by campaign. For Meta's own funnel use get_sales_funnel. Saved data from the daily visitor review.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
